dataset: NBA 2026-27 regular-season team box-score game log (final scores, 11/01/2026 - 11/02/2026)
collection_method: Each row is one team's line from the NBA.com 'Teams Box Scores' table, transcribed from the rendered page (fetch_page), newest first. Scores were cross-checked against the per-game NBA.com game pages where those pages were read (see cross_checks).
notes: Only games dated 11/01/2026 and 11/02/2026 are present: those are the two most recent game dates in the season-to-date table, and they are the complete set of dates for which every row was readable in the rendered text.
MIN is the team's total minutes in the game as published by NBA.com (240 = regulation, 265 = one overtime period).
OT is derived only from MIN: MIN == 240 gives 0, MIN == 265 gives 1. Any other MIN value was left out of the dataset rather than guessed.
This is a convenience subset for calibration examples. It is NOT a complete season sample and must not be described as one.

cross_checks.claim: BOS 93 at HOU 109, final; quarter scores 29-29, 21-28, 23-25, 20-27; 8:30 PM, Toyota Center

known_gaps: Games played 2026-10-31 and earlier are published by NBA.com but were not transcribed here (the rendered table is paginated and only the newest pages were read).
PHX has played 5 games per NBA.com advanced stats but only 2 appear in this subset.
No odds, spreads, totals or prop lines are present: NBA.com does not render market prices on its pages (verified on the standings, stats, schedule and game-summary pages).
